source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: 18 adds on top of the 135 local entries MI already held: county parks (Newaygo's White Cloud, Isabella's Coldwater Lake, Mecosta's Paris Park, Charlevoix's Whiting Park, Kalkaska's Log Lake, Arenac's Point Au Gres, Oceana's Black Lake) and city/village/township campgrounds (Montague, Evart, Marion, Empire, Port Huron Twp, Wolverine, Vassar, Breen Twp, Drummond Island, Eastlake, Bates Twp). Excluded seasonal-dominated Branch County Memorial Park, equestrian/primitive/group camps. The private gap here is large (Steamboat Park near Grand Rapids among ~150).
